inclusion_criteria: Confirmed diagnosis of Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (GPA)
Active disease with Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score (BVAS) of 3 or greater
Failed or intolerant to at least one standard immunosuppressive therapy (cyclophosphamide, rituximab, or methotrexate)
Adequate bone marrow function (ANC > 1500/μL, platelets > 100,000/μL, hemoglobin > 9 g/dL)
exclusion_criteria: Diagnosis of Microscopic Polyangiitis (MPA) or Eosinophilic Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (EGPA)
Active serious infection requiring IV antibiotics within 4 weeks
Current immunosuppressive therapy (must complete 4-week washout; corticosteroids ≤10mg/day prednisone equivalent permitted)
Concurrent enrollment in another interventional clinical trial
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or plans to become pregnant during study
History of malignancy within 3 years (except treated basal cell carcinoma)
Liver enzymes (ALT or AST) greater than 3 times upper limit of normal
Active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV infection
History of gastrointestinal perforation or diverticulitis
primary_endpoint: Proportion achieving clinical remission (BVAS 0) at Week 24
important_notes: This trial is specifically for GPA (PR3-ANCA positive). Patients with MPO-ANCA-associated vasculitis have a different disease mechanism and are not eligible. Confirm ANCA subtype with most recent laboratory results.
